dialogues.jp: 「お？　ありゃ、ことりか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh? Is that Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Oh? Is that Kotori?"

dialogues.jp:
商店街をこちらに歩いてくる。その姿に、鳩を
連想した。
dialogues.en:
She was walking around the shopping district randomly. Her
movements were like that of a pigeon.
dialogues.text:
She was walking around the shopping district randomly. Her
movements were like that of a pigeon.

dialogues.jp:
鳩って歩く時に前後に首を振るのだが、それを
左右に変えたっていう感じの。
dialogues.en:
That is, how a pigeon takes a few steps while constantly
turning it's head sideways, looking left and right
constantly.
dialogues.text:
That is, how a pigeon takes a few steps while constantly
turning it's head sideways, looking left and right
constantly.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、要するに、きょろきょろしながら歩いて
るって事だ。
dialogues.en:
Well, she probably needs something that requires her to pay
attention to everything in sight...
dialogues.text:
Well, she probably needs something that requires her to pay
attention to everything in sight...

dialogues.jp: 「何か、挙動不審だな」
dialogues.en: "You're acting quite suspiciously, Miss Kotori."
dialogues.text: "You're acting quite suspiciously, Miss Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あ、朝倉君。こんちわっす」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun. Good afternoon!"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun. Good afternoon!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「こんちは。ちゃんと前向いて歩かないと、変
　な奴に、肩外れたぞオルァ、とかからまれる
　ぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"Good afternoon. You should look in front of you when you
walk, you know?"
dialogues.text:
"Good afternoon. You should look in front of you when you
walk, you know?"

dialogues.jp:
ことりと話していると、どうしてもいつもとは
違うテンションまで持ち上げられる。
dialogues.en:
As I talked to Kotori, I noticed she was definitely
different from normal; she had a weird tension around her.
dialogues.text:
As I talked to Kotori, I noticed she was definitely
different from normal; she had a weird tension around her.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな時は、朝倉君が助けてくれるから大丈
　夫ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"If you could help me with something, everything should be
fine..."
dialogues.text:
"If you could help me with something, everything should be
fine..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「はてさて、ご期待に添えますやら。んで、ど
　うかしたの？　誰かを捜してるとか？」
dialogues.en:
"I'd be happy to fulfil your expectations. What's up? Are
you looking for someone?"
dialogues.text:
"I'd be happy to fulfil your expectations. What's up? Are
you looking for someone?"

dialogues.jp: 通行人の邪魔にならないよう、端の方に寄った。
dialogues.en: I look around at the passers-by.
dialogues.text: I look around at the passers-by.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん。違いますよ」
dialogues.en: "No, not quite."
dialogues.text: "No, not quite."

dialogues.jp:
ぱたぱたと、ことりが手を振ってそう言った時
だった。
dialogues.en: As she said that, she waved behind me.
dialogues.text: As she said that, she waved behind me.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あ、こんなところにいた。探したよ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Ah, here you are. I was looking for you, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Ah, here you are. I was looking for you, Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
工藤が手を振りながらやってくる。にこりと笑
うと白い歯が覗いたりして、相変わらず爽やか
な奴だ。
dialogues.en:
Kudou waved back, with a smile showing his pearly-white
teeth. Ever-pleasant as usual.
dialogues.text:
Kudou waved back, with a smile showing his pearly-white
teeth. Ever-pleasant as usual.

dialogues.jp: やってきた工藤とことりを見て。
dialogues.en: I look back and forth at Kudou and Kotori.
dialogues.text: I look back and forth at Kudou and Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
「もしかして俺、馬に蹴られて死んじゃったり
　する？」
dialogues.en: "Am I interrupting something here?"
dialogues.text: "Am I interrupting something here?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ち、違いますよ！　その認識は間違ってま
　すっ！」
dialogues.en: "N, no! It's not what you think!"
dialogues.text: "N, no! It's not what you think!"

dialogues.jp: なぜか慌てることり。
dialogues.en: Kotori had a rare bout of disconcertedness.
dialogues.text: Kotori had a rare bout of disconcertedness.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「工藤君にはちょっとお願いがしてあって」
dialogues.en: "I asked Kudou-kun for a favour."
dialogues.text: "I asked Kudou-kun for a favour."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お願い？」
dialogues.en: "A favour?"
dialogues.text: "A favour?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ええ」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
俺を説得するかのように、大きくうなずいてみ
せる。
dialogues.en:
Trying her hardest to convince me, she gave a big nod to my
question.
dialogues.text:
Trying her hardest to convince me, she gave a big nod to my
question.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「えっと、実はですね、私、あるものを探して
　て……」
dialogues.en: "Uhm, the truth is, I'm seatching for something..."
dialogues.text: "Uhm, the truth is, I'm seatching for something..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「たまたま出会ったオレは、それを手伝うこと
　にしたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "We met by chance while walking here, so I decided to help."
dialogues.text: "We met by chance while walking here, so I decided to help."

dialogues.jp:
俺とことりとがたまたま出会ったように、こと
りと工藤とがたまたま出会ってもおかしくない
わけだ。
dialogues.en:
I met Kotori by chance, and Kotori met Kudou by chance.
Nothing strange about that.
dialogues.text:
I met Kotori by chance, and Kotori met Kudou by chance.
Nothing strange about that.

dialogues.jp:
そう言う偶然はよくあることだからな。うんう
ん。
dialogues.en: Meeting my chance happens all the time after all... hah.
dialogues.text: Meeting my chance happens all the time after all... hah.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「最近、ことりには色々お世話になってるから
　さ」
dialogues.en: "Recently, Kotori has been asking my help for everything."
dialogues.text: "Recently, Kotori has been asking my help for everything."

dialogues.jp: そう言って工藤が柔らかく微笑む。
dialogues.en: Kudou grinned jokingly at Kotori with his words.
dialogues.text: Kudou grinned jokingly at Kotori with his words.

dialogues.jp:
一体どんなお世話をされたら、こんな笑みを浮
かべることができるんか。……いいけど。
dialogues.en:
I wonder what kind of things Kotori has been asking his help
for to make him smile like that... well, whatever.
dialogues.text:
I wonder what kind of things Kotori has been asking his help
for to make him smile like that... well, whatever.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、あれですよ。ひとりよりふたり、って
　奴です」
dialogues.en: "Well, of course. Two heads are better than one."
dialogues.text: "Well, of course. Two heads are better than one."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「んで、その人海戦術でもって、一体何を探し
　てるんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"So, with these human-wave tactics at hand, what exactly are
we looking for?
dialogues.text:
"So, with these human-wave tactics at hand, what exactly are
we looking for?

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「お姉ちゃんへのプレゼントですよ」
dialogues.en: "A present for my sister."
dialogues.text: "A present for my sister."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ああ、なるほど……暦先生、還暦を迎えるか
　らなぁ」
dialogues.en:
"Ahh, I see... Koyomi-sensei's about to hit the big 6-0,
huh..."
dialogues.text:
"Ahh, I see... Koyomi-sensei's about to hit the big 6-0,
huh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「え？　そうだったの？　オレ、もっとずっと
　若いかと思ってた……」
dialogues.en:
"Eh? Really? I've always thought she looked a bit
younger..."
dialogues.text:
"Eh? Really? I've always thought she looked a bit
younger..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「若いです！」
dialogues.en: "Of course she is!"
dialogues.text: "Of course she is!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「もう。本人に聞かれたら、爪の間に虫ピン入
　れられますよ」
dialogues.en:
"Geez, if she had heard it, she'd be crushing both of you
like insects now."
dialogues.text:
"Geez, if she had heard it, she'd be crushing both of you
like insects now."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そ、それは怖いな……」
dialogues.en: "S, scaaary..."
dialogues.text: "S, scaaary..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「冗談ですって」
dialogues.en: "Just joking."
dialogues.text: "Just joking."

dialogues.jp:
唇にちょこんと指をあて、ことりがにっこり微
笑む。
dialogues.en: Kotori put her finger to her lips teasingly.
dialogues.text: Kotori put her finger to her lips teasingly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「せいぜい、変な突きを喰らうくらいですよ」
dialogues.en: We definitely can't get anything weird for her though."
dialogues.text: We definitely can't get anything weird for her though."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「変な突き？　何だ、そりゃ」
dialogues.en: "Anything weird? What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Anything weird? What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「お姉ちゃんって、飽きっぽいんですけど、色
　んな趣味があるんですよね」
dialogues.en:
"My sister's tired of weird presents, since she doesn't
really have any special interests that have good present
ideas."
dialogues.text:
"My sister's tired of weird presents, since she doesn't
really have any special interests that have good present
ideas."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「この前は、｛はっきょくけん／八極拳｝とかって拳法にはまってま
　した」
dialogues.en:
"And she's recently learned the Hakkyokuken fighting
style..."
dialogues.text:
"And she's recently learned the Hakkyokuken fighting
style..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「そうなんだ……。これからは色々気をつけな
　いといけないな」
dialogues.en:
"Is that so... we better be careful about what we get for
her, then..."
dialogues.text:
"Is that so... we better be careful about what we get for
her, then..."

dialogues.jp: 工藤が微妙に蒼ざめた表情で呟くと。
dialogues.en:
Kudou murmured, obviously not experienced in matters
involving Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text:
Kudou murmured, obviously not experienced in matters
involving Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「工藤君は大丈夫ですよ」
dialogues.en: "It'd be okay for you, Kudou-kun."
dialogues.text: "It'd be okay for you, Kudou-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「どうして工藤だと大丈夫なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why's it alright for him?"
dialogues.text: "Why's it alright for him?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それは……」
dialogues.en: "Uh, well..."
dialogues.text: "Uh, well..."

dialogues.jp: ことりが工藤の顔をちらりと窺う。
dialogues.en: Kotori unconciously glaced at Kudou's face.
dialogues.text: Kotori unconciously glaced at Kudou's face.

dialogues.jp: 「…………やっぱり顔か」
dialogues.en: "......It's the face, isn't it?"
dialogues.text: "......It's the face, isn't it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Face?"
dialogues.text: "Face?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「顔がいいと、何でも許されるんだな。可愛い
　女の子なら、どれだけ傍若無人に振る舞おう
　と許せてしまえるようにっ！」
dialogues.en:
"With that kind of face, anyone could forgive him. He could
act like an uncaring idiot to girls and no one would punish
him!"
dialogues.text:
"With that kind of face, anyone could forgive him. He could
act like an uncaring idiot to girls and no one would punish
him!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あははははは……は……」
dialogues.en: "Ahahahaha... ha..."
dialogues.text: "Ahahahaha... ha..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、そう言うことにしておいてください」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you want to believe that, please do so."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you want to believe that, please do so."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「悔しいが、そう言うことにしておこう」
dialogues.en: "Unfortunately, I don't have much choice but to."
dialogues.text: "Unfortunately, I don't have much choice but to."

dialogues.jp:
努力で顔立ちの良さは何とか出来ないから……
ここは黙って涙を飲むことにした。
dialogues.en:
I have to work hard for the natural advantages that a pretty
face gives... such a pitiful matter.
dialogues.text:
I have to work hard for the natural advantages that a pretty
face gives... such a pitiful matter.

dialogues.jp:
まぁ、努力でどうにか出来るとしても、かった
るいのでやらないと思うが。
dialogues.en:
Well, I suppose "working hard" for that isn't that much of a
chore either.
dialogues.text:
Well, I suppose "working hard" for that isn't that much of a
chore either.

dialogues.jp:
「んで、プレゼントだけど、還暦のお祝いが違
　うんなら、誕生日プレゼント？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, if it's not the big 6-0, then what's the present for?
A normal birthday one?"
dialogues.text:
"Well, if it's not the big 6-0, then what's the present for?
A normal birthday one?"

dialogues.jp:
クリスマスでもないし、プレゼントって言った
ら、そこら辺か。
dialogues.en:
It's nowhere close to Christmas, so that's the only reason I
could think of.
dialogues.text:
It's nowhere close to Christmas, so that's the only reason I
could think of.

dialogues.jp:
工藤も興味津々と言った感じで、ことりを見る。
プレゼント選びをすると言ったものの、どうい
う目的か聞いてなかったのかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
Kudou also looked towards Kotori with interest. Neither of
us had heard the actual reason for the present, apparently.
dialogues.text:
Kudou also looked towards Kotori with interest. Neither of
us had heard the actual reason for the present, apparently.

dialogues.jp: ……意外と間抜けな奴だ。
dialogues.en: ...Surprisingly clueless for him.
dialogues.text: ...Surprisingly clueless for him.

dialogues.jp: 俺が思っていると。
dialogues.en: Probably not common, I think.
dialogues.text: Probably not common, I think.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、違うんです。けっ──」
dialogues.en: "Mmm, not quite. It's for her ma--"
dialogues.text: "Mmm, not quite. It's for her ma--"

dialogues.jp:
絶句、という奴。ことりは目をまん丸くし、口
を手で覆った。
dialogues.en:
She cut herself off mid-speech, her eyes round and her hand
on her mouth.
dialogues.text:
She cut herself off mid-speech, her eyes round and her hand
on her mouth.

dialogues.jp: 「毛？　……毛って言ったのか？」
dialogues.en: "Ma..? Her mother? And yours too, I guess?"
dialogues.text: "Ma..? Her mother? And yours too, I guess?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。オレの聞こえ間違えじゃなければ、そ
　う言ってたぞ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, that's what I heard too."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, that's what I heard too."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う、ううん、違うんですよ」
dialogues.en: "N, no, not that..."
dialogues.text: "N, no, not that..."

dialogues.jp: しまったなあという顔で、ふるふる首を振った。
dialogues.en:
Her face showed regret about what she almost said, as she
shook her head furiously.
dialogues.text:
Her face showed regret about what she almost said, as she
shook her head furiously.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、言っちゃマズイ事なら、聞かないけど」
dialogues.en: "Well, if you can't say it, it's okay."
dialogues.text: "Well, if you can't say it, it's okay."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ごめんなさい。そうしてもらえますか」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry. Just treat it like a normal present."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry. Just treat it like a normal present."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「了解」
dialogues.en: "Understood."
dialogues.text: "Understood."

dialogues.jp:
まあ、そういう事なら、詮索しない方がいいだ
ろう。
dialogues.en: Well, if that's how it is, I better not pry any further.
dialogues.text: Well, if that's how it is, I better not pry any further.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そうだ。もし良かったら、これからプレゼン
　ト選びに付き合ってもらえません？」
dialogues.en: "So anyway, could you go with me to choose a present?"
dialogues.text: "So anyway, could you go with me to choose a present?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「俺もか？」
dialogues.en: "Me as well now?"
dialogues.text: "Me as well now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「さっき言ったじゃないですか。ふたりより３
　人だって」
dialogues.en: "Didn't I say so earlier? Three heads are better than two."
dialogues.text: "Didn't I say so earlier? Three heads are better than two."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「微妙に変わってるぞ」
dialogues.en: "...That's a bit different from earlier, I think."
dialogues.text: "...That's a bit different from earlier, I think."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「気にしちゃ駄目ですよ！」
dialogues.en: "Not a problem!"
dialogues.text: "Not a problem!"

dialogues.jp: 親指を立てて、グッと突き出してくる。
dialogues.en: Kotori gave me the thumbs up.
dialogues.text: Kotori gave me the thumbs up.

dialogues.jp: いや、そんなハイテンションに言われても。
dialogues.en: Somehow, I got an uneasy feeling from this...
dialogues.text: Somehow, I got an uneasy feeling from this...

dialogues.jp: （さて、どうしようかな……）
dialogues.en: "(Well, what should I do...)"
dialogues.text: "(Well, what should I do...)"

dialogues.jp: 暦先生のプレゼントねえ……
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei's present, huh...'
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei's present, huh...'

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生へのプレゼント◆
dialogues.en: ◆A Present for Koyomi-sensei◆
dialogues.text: ◆A Present for Koyomi-sensei◆

dialogues.jp:
何やら、暦先生へのプレゼントを探していると
いうことりと出会った。
dialogues.en:
For apparently unspeakable reasons, I met Kotori while she
was searching for a present for Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text:
For apparently unspeakable reasons, I met Kotori while she
was searching for a present for Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp:
途中、工藤も合流して、そして、俺も一緒に探
してくれと言ってくるのだが……。
dialogues.en:
We hooked up with Kudou on the way, and she asked whether I
could search together with her...
dialogues.text:
We hooked up with Kudou on the way, and she asked whether I
could search together with her...
